BookingNotificationTrigger.title: Booking Notification Trigger
BookingNotificationTrigger.description: Defines when and how notifications are sent on booking lifecycle events (created, changed, cancelled, reminder). Stored declaratively per ADR-031.

eventType.description: Booking lifecycle event that fires this trigger.

active.description: Whether this trigger is currently enabled.

bookingId.description: Optional UUID of a specific booking this trigger applies to. Null = global trigger.

templateId.description: UUID of the BookingNotificationTemplate to use when this trigger fires.

recipients.description: Ordered list of recipient rules evaluated when the trigger fires.

role.description: Recipient role: customer, organizer, or admin_group.

channels.description: Preferred delivery channels in priority order.

condition.description: Simple expression evaluated against the booking object. Rule is skipped if false.

rateLimitPerBookingPerHour.description: Maximum notifications per booking per hour. Default 10.

rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay.description: Maximum notifications per organizer per day. Default 100.

deduplicationWindowMinutes.description: Deduplicate identical recipient+trigger sends within this window (minutes). Default 5.

BookingNotificationTemplate.title: Booking Notification Template
BookingNotificationTemplate.description: Content template for booking notifications. Subject and body use Twig-style {{ variable }} substitution. Stored declaratively per ADR-031.

trigger.description: Which booking event uses this template.

subject.description: Notification subject line. Supports {{ booking.* }}, {{ recipient.* }}, {{ system.* }} variables.
subject.example: Bevestiging boeking {{ booking.organizer }} - {{ booking.startTime | date('d M Y') }}

body.description: Notification body text. Supports {{ booking.* }}, {{ recipient.* }}, {{ system.* }} variables.
body.example:
Hallo {{ booking.guestName }},

Uw boeking is bevestigd.

...

NotificationDelivery.title: Notification Delivery
NotificationDelivery.description: Audit trail record for every notification dispatch attempt. Tamper-evident per ADR-022. Never deleted.

triggerName.description: Name of the trigger that fired.

bookingId.description: UUID of the booking this notification is for.

recipient.description: Recipient address (email, phone, or chat ID). PII — handle per AVG/GDPR.

templateName.description: Name of the template rendered for this send.

failureReason.description: Error message if status is failed or skipped.

sentAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the send was attempted.
